hero.subtitle: Not just another AI planner. Luna works with you, every step towards your perfect trip.

howItWorks.label: How it works
howItWorks.title: As easy as 1, 2, 3
howItWorks.subtitle: Tell us where you want to go. Luna handles everything else, in seconds.
howItWorks.step1Title: Tell Luna where you want to go
howItWorks.step1Body: Type your destination, travel dates, and who you are travelling with. That is all it takes to get started.
howItWorks.step2Body: Luna builds your complete itinerary with activities, stays, budget breakdown, weather tips, and local transport options.
howItWorks.step3Body: Chat with Luna to tweak anything. Swap days, add ideas, change your style. Save your trip and head out with confidence.

features.label: What you get
features.title: Everything in every plan
features.subtitle: Every trip Luna builds comes fully loaded. No upgrades, no paywalls, no surprises.
features.itineraryBody: A full schedule with timings, activity descriptions, insider tips, and local recommendations tailored to your style.
features.hotelsBody: Curated stay options matched to your budget and location preferences, near the activities in your plan.
features.weatherBody: Know what to expect and what to pack. Luna factors in seasonal weather and events so there are no unpleasant surprises.
features.transportBody: Transport options for every leg of your trip, from airport transfers to local taxis, trains, and everything in between.
features.budgetBody: A clear cost estimate across accommodation, food, activities, and transport. Know what you will spend before you go.
features.chatBody: Ask Luna anything about your trip. Adjust days, add activities, get local advice. She is always one message away.

footer.tagline: AI-powered travel planning that feels human. Built for travellers who want something more personal.
